data.long_meaning: The name Inga comes from Old Norse, meaning 'belonging to Ing'. Ing is a god in Germanic mythology, related to fertility and agriculture. Berg means mountain. Thus, Ingaberg means 'belonging to Ing, the mountain goddess'. The name Ingaberg carries the meaning “Inga's mountain” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ingaberg usually hope their child will grow to embody inga's mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
